answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x under peak settlement writes; rollback is forbidden by the security-patch constraint, so memory_b1 is not actionable. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails fast and risks dropping customer writes, which violates the objective. Intended move is guarded add_capacity because memory_b3 links headroom to absorbing write surges without shedding traffic; verifying b3 (mid-peak vs pre-peak) and b5 (whether offloading reads, not writes, was what recovered primary latency) before committing. Residual uncertainty remains: the 2h-old release is a plausible cause that capacity may not fix, and failover/replica routing are unproven for this write-heavy peak.
